actions.message: Large contributions hurt the group, keep it low

answer.explanation: Resident5 contributed >30 units in the last round, so I punish them with the maximum severity affordable (floor(20.44/0.3)=68). I also broadcast the standard discouraging reminder.

message.reasoning:
We need decide based on rules. Latest round 6 history: contributions >30? In round6 contributions: Resident5 39.94 (>30), Resident3 5.4675, Resident6 5.47. So Resident5 gave >30. So we must punish that resident with max severity affordable: severity = floor(wallet / punishment_cost). wallet=20.44, punishment_cost=0.3 => floor(20.44/0.3)= floor(68.133)=68. So punish Resident5 severity 68. Cost: 68*0.3=20.4 which is within wallet. After punishment wallet reduces to ~0.04 left.

Also we can broadcast message discouraging large contributions.

We can do one physical and one communication. So physical punish, communication broadcast.

Return JSON.
